mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, question_type, stem, options, correct_answer, explanation, reference_answer, sample_answer, scoring_rubric, source_id, group_sort_order, difficulty, knowledge_points, content_fingerprint, review_status, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM exam_question WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, group_type, title, instruction, content, shared_options, source_id, difficulty, knowledge_points, content_fingerprint, review_status, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM exam_question_group WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, group_type, title, instruction, content, shared_options, source_id, difficulty, knowledge_points, content_fingerprint, review_status, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM exam_question_group WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, group_id, question_type, stem, options, correct_answer, explanation, reference_answer, sample_answer, scoring_rubric, source_id, group_sort_order, difficulty, knowledge_points, content_fingerprint, review_status, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM exam_question WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_question_group g INNER JOIN exam_question_source group_source ON group_source.id = g.source_id SET g.review_status = 'APPROVED', g.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE g.id = #{groupId} AND group_source.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND group_source.copyright_status IN ('ORIGINAL', 'AUTHORIZED', 'PUBLIC_OFFICIAL') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exam_question member WHERE member.group_id = g.id) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exam_question member LEFT JOIN exam_question_source member_source ON member_source.id = member.source_id WHERE member.group_id = g.id AND (member.source_id <> g.source_id OR member_source.review_status <> 'APPROVED' OR member_source.copyright_status NOT IN ('ORIGINAL', 'AUTHORIZED', 'PUBLIC_OFFICIAL')) )

UPDATE exam_question member INNER JOIN exam_question_group g ON g.id = member.group_id INNER JOIN exam_question_source source ON source.id = member.source_id SET member.review_status = 'APPROVED', member.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE member.group_id = #{groupId} AND member.source_id = g.source_id AND source.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND source.copyright_status IN ('ORIGINAL', 'AUTHORIZED', 'PUBLIC_OFFICIAL')

UPDATE exam_question question INNER JOIN exam_question_source source ON source.id = question.source_id SET question.review_status = 'APPROVED', question.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE question.id = #{id} AND source.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND source.copyright_status IN ('ORIGINAL', 'AUTHORIZED', 'PUBLIC_OFFICIAL')
UPDATE exam_question_group SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{groupId} AND #{enabled} IN (0, 1)
UPDATE exam_question SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND #{enabled} IN (0, 1)
UPDATE exam_question SET enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND #{enabled} IN (0, 1)
